audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2], [3] and [5] why-strings were generic and gave the first-item row to Quinn's Youmuu's timing.
audit.why: The spike that matters at first item is his health item plus Infected Bonesaw's current-health poke, which outlasts a lethality build.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to blind his 'cleaver-empowered autos' in three places.
audit.why: Infected Bonesaw is a thrown projectile, not an auto empowerment — the blind cannot touch it. Blunt Force Trauma IS his empowered attack (9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6), so that is what a blind eats. Heart Zapper stores the damage you deal and heals him off the burst, which is why Grievous Wounds must land before you commit, not after.
